name: Zoomobile
description: All Aboard for a Wild Ride! Climb aboard the Zoomobile for a fun ride through your Toronto Zoo!

name: Conservation Carousel
description: Carousels are timeless and fun for all ages! Hop on and choose a unique animal seat.

name: Greenhouse
description: Take a self-guided tour of our Greenhouse, full of plants from around the world.

name: Wildlife Health & Science Centre
description: Step inside one of the most advanced wildlife health and science facilities in Canada.

name: Virtual Reality (VR) Theatre!
description: An interactive adventure! This fully immersive technology will transport you from Scarborough to various locations around          the world. Three Shows to Choose From!

name: TundraAir Ride
description: Soar through the air at speeds of 48km/hr over the Tundra Trek on the TundraAir Ride.

name: Gorilla Climb Ropes Course
description: Hang out like the gorilla troop do! Swing, crawl and balance on 26 elements almost 33 feet high!

name: Splash Island
description: Cool off at our 2-acre splash pad, filled with water-spouting animals.

name: Face Painting, Caricatures and Henna!
description: Transform into your favorite animal with our talented face painters and caricature artists!
